issues.description: StockIngredient's quantity getter is inconsistently named across artifacts: the template repository defines retrieveQuantity() (template StockIngredient.java line 36), while the solution repository (and typical usage expected by the UML/other classes) uses getQuantity() (solution StockIngredient.java line 36). This API mismatch can block students (and template code) from compiling when reading ingredient quantities.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template StockIngredient, rename retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or add a public getQuantity() method that returns quantity and optionally keep retrieveQuantity() for backward compatibility.
